prerequisites: Node.js 20 and npm. CI tests on Node 20.

steps.title: Start PostgreSQL
steps.text: This container uses the CI image. It is for local use only: PostgreSQL accepts connections without a password.

steps.title: Set the connection URL
steps.text: The migrations, the tests, and the server read this variable. Set it again in each new terminal.

steps.title: Run the tests
steps.text: At this commit, `npm test` stops before any test runs: `server/services/TrustService.spec.js` fails with `TypeError: Cannot stub non-existent property trustRelationshipGetById`. Run the integration tests and the repository tests one at a time. Both pass.

steps.title: Start the server
steps.text: The server reads a JWT key pair from `.env.development`. For local work, copy the test key pair from `.env.ci`. To make your own key pair, follow the README. The API listens on http://localhost:3006. A request without an API key, for example to `/wallets`, gets a 401 response.
